title: Power loss for the local Mizohata–Takeuchi estimate on smooth hypersurfaces
abstract: Lean 4 formalization of the following power-type loss in the local  Mizohata–Takeuchi estimate. For each $0<\beta\le 1$, there is an exponent $\alpha_\beta>0$ such that, in every dimension $d\ge 1$, each $C^{2,\beta}$ hypersurface $\Sigma\subset\mathbb{R}^{d+1}$ whose second fundamental form is nonzero at some point satisfies $\mathcal{C}_\Sigma(R)\ge c_\Sigma R^{\alpha_\beta}$ for all $R\ge R_\Sigma$. Here $\mathcal{C}_\Sigma(R)$ is the local Mizohata–Takeuchi constant, and the positive constant $c_\Sigma$ and threshold $R_\Sigma$ may depend on $\Sigma$.
